classification.rationale: Brass pipe is a copper-zinc base alloy tube of heading 7411, and its decorative use does not change that since the pipe is not further worked into an article. Subheading 7411.21 covers brass tubes and pipes, split by seamless (7411.21.10) versus other (7411.21.50). The description names seamless pipe first, so it is classified in 7411.21.10.00, and the ERW pipe would fall in 7411.21.50.00. No ruling was found on this exact good.
